verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a DIY state backend that stores state in an object store you manage (AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage), and its pricing page lists self-hosting, so users can control where their state data lives. Region or residency selection is not stated explicitly; it is only implied by bucket ownership, and a community comment notes self-hosting is limited to the Enterprise Edition. missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection for the managed Pulumi Cloud backend, explicit residency guarantees, self-hosting outside the Enterprise tier, independent corroboration.
